title: I’d like to display my next alarm on my Lock Screen.
body:
Using the Lasso app’s ‘Next Alarm’ widget allows you to see your next scheduled alarm directly from your Lock Screen. This is the best way to ensure you don’t forget to set an alarm or forget to toggle off an alarm.

To use the widget, press and hold on your Lock Screen. Tap the ‘Customize’ button that appears at the bottom of the screen, tap ‘Add Widgets,’ scroll down to Lasso then select one of the two size options.

You can also place a more subtle, text-only widget above your Lock Screen’s time display, by tapping the rectangular box around the date instead of tapping the ‘Add Widgets’ button.
